text:
Type: black metal three-tier shelving unit
Use: displaying plants, books and small decor, storing towels; living room, bedroom, bathroom
Style: traditional, farmhouse, classic
Materials: black powder-coated steel frame, perforated metal shelves, clear glass top shelf
Colors: matte black, clear glass
Shape: tall narrow open frame on four slim legs with ball feet, scrolled wrought-iron crest along the top, dotted pattern on the shelves, light and see-through, compact
Feel: romantic, vintage, airy, delicate
Goes with: white walls, pale wood, wicker baskets, green plants; farmhouse, cottage or classic rooms
